questions.q: You need to load 300,000 Contact records. Which tool fits best?
options: None; Salesforce can't load that many
questions.explain: The wizard is capped at 50,000 records, and Data Loader is built for large volumes.

questions.q: You want a quick answer to a one-off question about a few records, with no install. Which tool fits best?
questions.explain: Workbench runs in a browser and suits fast, ad hoc queries.

questions.q: An administrator has a 5,000-row CSV of new Leads, a one-time load. Which tool is a good fit?
options: Data Loader is required; nothing else can load Leads
questions.explain: A small, one-time load of a supported object is what the wizard is designed for.

questions.q: Why can't the Import Wizard be used for a bulk delete?
options: Deletes are not allowed in Salesforce
It is import only; it cannot export or delete records
It only works on Sandbox orgs
questions.explain: Delete and export need Data Loader or Workbench.

questions.q: A load will run every week from your billing system's customer file. What is the best pattern?
options: Repeated manual inserts in the Import Wizard
Data Loader upsert on an External ID field
Copy and paste rows into Workbench
questions.explain: Upsert on a stable key is safe to re-run and doesn't create duplicates.
